title: RapidOCR 本地识别（减少检测内存）
network_isolation: macOS sandbox-exec deny network*; new base and shared private venv read-only; unavailable isolation blocks execution
registration_boundary: Source-owned fixed profile; no arbitrary runtime, manifest, model or interpreter registration and no automatic profile replacement of existing OCR authorizations.
compatibility: Default m49 and low-memory-v1 constants, recorded authorizations/results and rendering remain unchanged. Only explicit new requests may select this registered profile; no live default retargeting.
qualification: Two isolated same-PNG probes (page112 and independently reviewed page9) stayed below unchanged observed 1GiB/90s guards. Page112 table reading order differs from native extraction; these probes do not prove table semantics, whole-report accuracy, or product integration.
license: Same pinned model/code/notices as the private m49 runtime; no model or interpreter bytes changed by this profile.
